channel.title: The Virginia Gazette - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Virginia Gazette (vagazette.com)

item.title: James City County police officers shoot and kill man inside York County Home Depot
item.description: Two James City County police officers shot and killed a man Wednesday afternoon who they said was coming after them with a claw hammer inside a Home Depot in York County, according to York-Poquoson Sheriff Ron Montgomery.

item.title: Virginia Wesleyan men, CNU women pick up basketball victories
item.description: TJ East scored a game-high 22 points and made 11 of 12 free throws to lead VWU to a come-from-behind ODAC victory at Hampden-Sydney.

item.title: ODU jumps ahead early, holds off Arkansas State to end string of tight losses
item.description: Jordan Battle scored 20 points and made 5 of 8 3-point attempts, including a half-court shot to close the first half, and KC Shaw added 16 points and two late free throws.

item.title: Riley Stack’s career night lifts ODU women to lopsided win over ULM
item.description: Stack continued a recent tear, scoring in double figures for the ninth time in the past 12 games.

item.title: High school scoreboard: No. 4 Norview outscores No. 12 Granby in Eastern District basketball
item.description: Top-ranked Grassfield won their final wrestling meet of the regular season by sweeping Cape Henry Collegiate 67-0.

item.title: Today in History: January 29, Bush warns of ‘axis of evil’
item.description: President George W. Bush said terrorists were still threatening America — and warned of “an axis of evil” consisting of North Korea, Iran and Iraq.

item.title: Unmentioned but present, Trump is a common denominator in efforts to strengthen Asia-Europe ties
item.description: Trump's shaking up of the global order is worrying friends and foes and driving them closer.

item.title: US appeals court says Noem’s decision to end protections for Venezuelans in US was illegal
item.description: The decision will not have any immediate practical effect after the Supreme Court in October allowed Noem’s decision to take effect pending a final decision by the justices.

item.title: New videos show Alex Pretti scuffle with federal officers in Minneapolis 11 days before his death
item.description: The new videos have rekindled the national debate about the death of Pretti.

item.title: New floodwall in front of Virginia Beach Boardwalk under consideration
item.description: The five-year Coastal Storm Risk Management Feasibility Study for Virginia Beach will be completed in 2028. It's still early in the design process, but several potential structural measures are being considered for vulnerable areas.
